no_new_GT_use: per-pose correctness labels already in the 33-24 rows only
motivation: Mock review of 2026-11-21: with random per-frame sign flips of real cached scores, the released check v1.0 gives a definite direction in 5.0% of ten-frame draws on LM-O and 32.3% on XYZ-IBD, mostly because few sampled frames hold an opposite-label pair and the image bootstrap is degenerate with one such frame.

tool_v1_1.unit: informative image: an image with at least one opposite-label pair (same image, same object)
tool_v1_1.statistic: D = sum over informative images of d_i = wins_i + ties_i/2 - pairs_i/2 (pair-weighted pooled accuracy minus 0.5)
tool_v1_1.test: two-sided sign-flip randomization test across informative images: p = share of sign patterns e in {-1,+1}^n with |sum e_i d_i| >= |D| (tolerance 1e-12); exact enumeration for n <= 16, otherwise 20,000 random patterns from random.Random(seed) with p = (1 + count) / (1 + 20,000)
tool_v1_1.n_min: 6, the smallest n for which an exact two-sided sign-flip test can reach p < 0.05 (2^(1-n) < 0.05)
reading_order: reversed: p < 0.05 and the v1.0 image-bootstrap interval lies below 0.5
comparable: p < 0.05 and the v1.0 image-bootstrap interval lies above 0.5
tool_v1_1.property: v1.1 gives a direction only where v1.0 gives the same direction; it never creates a reversed or comparable reading that v1.0 did not give

N_null.what: negative control of the mock review: k frames drawn as in 33-24 B; each drawn frame independently keeps or negates all its scores with probability 1/2; candidates, labels, objects and within-frame structure unchanged
N_null.frame_rng: random.Random(f'null|{dataset}|{score}|{k}').sample(sorted frame keys incl. empty frames, k)
N_null.flip_rng: random.Random(f'flip|{dataset}|{score}|{k}|{draw}').random() < 0.5 per drawn frame, in sorted order of the drawn frames
N_null.outcome: definite = reversed or comparable; also no_pairs, too_few_images, not_comparable shares and the distribution of informative images

R_replay.what: 33-24 B replay repeated with v1.1, same frame draws and tool seeds (classic: random.Random(f'{dataset}|{score}|{k}'); WAPR pool: the 33-24 replay.py)
R_replay.expected: as in 33-24 (reversed: fp_raw, fp_single, wbps_neg; comparable: the others)

S_sequential.what: label frames one at a time in a random order until m frames are informative (or the 150 frames run out), then run v1.1 once
S_sequential.outcome: correct / insufficient / wrong shares; frames labelled (median, 90th percentile)

F_full.what: v1.1 on all 150 frames per dataset and pooled, every score of R_replay, seed 0

criteria.K1: N_null with v1.1: definite share <= 5% in every (dataset, score, k) cell -> 'the gated check gives a direction in at most 5% of draws without a common direction'; otherwise list cells
criteria.K2: R_replay fp_raw, k = 10, v1.1: correct >= 90% on every classic dataset -> ten random frames still suffice on the classic datasets; otherwise report the smallest k with correct >= 90% per dataset
criteria.K3: R_replay and S_sequential with v1.1: wrong <= 1% in every cell -> 'never the wrong direction'; otherwise list cells
criteria.K4: S_sequential m = 10, fp_raw: correct >= 95% on all six datasets -> recommend labelling frames until ten hold a correct and an incorrect pose, and report the frames this takes
criteria.K5: F_full: every v1.1 reading equals the v1.0 reading -> full-data statements unchanged; otherwise list

not_run_here: public submission files (33-23): their rows stay on the server; v1.1 can only turn a v1.0 direction into an insufficient reading, so 'no file holds a reversed confidence' holds under v1.1 without a rerun; the count of comparable files needs the server rerun (CPU, minutes) if quoted
